# One requirement per line; format: <source-L-doc>: <description>

L10: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
L10: Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
L10: Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
L10: Mode fault / collision detection.
L10: All clock polarity/phase combinations.
L10: MSB-first vs LSB-first byte ordering.
L10: Bidirectional mode (single data pin).
L10: Receive overrun (flag-serviced-too-late).
L10: Baud rate divisor sweep.
L10: Wait/Stop mode behavior.
L16: Exactly 1 Clock Lane (differential pair) + 1..4 Data Lanes (differential pairs).
L16: HS mode swing: 100-200 mV differential; 100 Ω termination at sink.
L16: LP mode swing: 1.2 V single-ended CMOS; unterminated.
L16: DDR Clock Lane: data-rate-per-lane = 2 × Clock-Lane Hz; both edges latch one Data-Lane bit.
L16: HS Entry: LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS-0 → Sync 8'b00011101 → payload.
L16: HS Exit: payload → HS-Trail → LP-11.
L16: Sync byte 8'b00011101 on every HS Entry, replicated on every active Data Lane.
L16: Header layout: DI (1B) + WC[15:0] (2B) + ECC (1B) for Long Packet; DI + Data[15:0] + ECC for Short Packet.
L16: Header ECC: extended Hamming(8,4) — must correct 1 bit, must detect 2 bits.
L16: Payload CRC-16: polynomial 0x1021 (x^16+x^12+x^5+1), init 0xFFFF, MSB-first, covers payload only.
L16: Multi-lane byte interleave: byte k → lane (k mod N).
L16: Inter-pair skew across lanes ≤ 100 ps; intra-pair Dp/Dn skew ≤ 5 ps.
L16: T-CLK-PRE ≥ 8 UI; T-CLK-POST ≥ 60 + 52 UI.
L16: T-HS-PREPARE / T-HS-ZERO / T-HS-TRAIL within D-PHY v1.x bounds.
L16: Frame sync: FS Short Packet (DT=0x00) at frame start; FE Short Packet (DT=0x01) at frame end.
L16: Stop state LP-11 ≥ T-HS-EXIT (100 ns) after every HS Exit.
